friction_events.description: Explicit connector safety denial on the first authority-bearing PIN CREATE; protocol required immediate terminal stop without retry or diversion.

decision_trace.decision: Stop the resident chain before authority.
decision_trace.observable_basis: The first authority CREATE was explicitly denied by connector safety controls; /wc v3.30 classifies that as CLAIM_TRANSPORT_BLOCKED and forbids retry/diversion.
decision_trace.action: Persisted a no-allocation transport-boundary receipt and terminal exam.
decision_trace.outcome: No job authority was created and no productive unit was claimed.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Ensure authorized reversible PIN CREATE operations matching the published /wc claim contract are representable without triggering an unrelated connector safety denial.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Fewer workers terminate before acquiring any authority.

exit_audit_v1.public_safe_summary: Fresh PROD-01 worker created its own v3.30 beacon, routed from the compact frontier, then hit an explicit connector safety denial on the first authority claim. It stopped without retry, recorded CLAIM_TRANSPORT_BLOCKED, and produced zero productive units.
